My 4th and latest TEDxFHNW talk is here, reposting this as I had made a mistake in the post last week. 

Has the age of hyper-digital connection altered our life forever? What will be the long term effects? Xenia Tchoumi brings up the scientific benefits of face to face connection and why we must return to basics in the way we communicate. 
This speech is a recording of the LIVE stream of the #TEDx streamed on May 15th, 2021.

#xenia #xeniatchoumi #tedtalk

node.title: TEDx | Physical connection is your cure.

This speech is a recording of the LIVE stream of the #TEDx streamed on May 15th, 2021.

node.text: No matter if I am in London, Switzerland, Russia or Italy - I am somehow always foreign. In the best sense of this word, because I truly don’t mind it. Being multicultural gave me richness in mentality and vision and made me embrace new cultures and ideas faster. I don’t have a strong sense of belonging but I do have a strong sense of gratitude towards all of the places and people that welcomed me and helped me become who I am today. As broadcasted today on the Swiss national television @srfvirus - sharing with you a little bit of my story (in Italian that’s my first language). This is a docu-series we filmed in Lugano, the town where I grew up. One of my first post lockdown trips, and it was wonderful.

Dump of the past days 

1. Secret fashion cover shoot with @adrianoartexcellence photography - still can’t believe this is happening, pinch me now!
2. Just like this view 👀 
3. Laughing cause I don’t let anyone touch my hair with heat
4. My favourite dessert & a @traxnyc diamond tennis
5. Backstage at the fashion shoot (9 looks in like 2 hours)
6. Freezing around Geneva
7. A little workout & sauna at arrival to my hotel 
8. My poke bowl room service
9. An incredible welcome at my suite at the @mo_geneva | collab 
10. My new powersuit uniform (expect to see a lot of this in the coming weeks)
12. I always forget how breathtaking the alps are
13. No better feeling than landing back home in London after a very productive work trip (siri play Ed Sheeran - Take Me Back To London)
